read.sections: Weak-lq covariance class and minimax rate Theorem 1, PDF pp.3-4; lower-bound Lemma 1 and Theorem 2, §§2-3; threshold upper bound §4; full proofs §7, pp.23-33.

read.sections: Matrix depth and Huber model §§1-3, PDF pp.1-12; modulus-of-continuity lower-bound Theorem 5.1, p.16; proofs in §7 and the included supplement, pp.23-53.
read.limitations: Theorem 3.1 requires bounded-spectrum F(M), epsilon<1/5, and C1(p+log(1/delta))/n<1; its minimax error is squared operator loss (p/n)∨epsilon^2. Structured sparse-depth class F_s is distinct from Cai-Zhou’s weak-lq class. The estimator is theoretically defined but computationally difficult at high dimension.
